changelog: Remote Support Access now stays switched on for 4 hours instead of 1. That window has to be long enough to cover the gap between you turning it on and Cytech Support picking it up, and customers live in time zones many hours away from ours. It still switches itself off automatically when the time is up, and you can still switch it off yourself at any moment.
details: v49 widens the Remote Support Access window from 1 hour to 4 hours, for time-zone coverage: a customer pressing the toggle while the operator is asleep used to leave nothing to connect to by morning, and customers run up to 12 h from Cytech's time zone. TWO constants encode the window and both move together: timer.remote_support_access's duration in packages/cytech.yaml ("01:00:00" -> "04:00:00", the HA-side timer that fires cytech_remote_support_timer_expired and so switches the toggle back off) and EXPIRES in enable_remote_support.sh (3600 -> 14400 seconds, the /config/.remote_support_expires_at timestamp that first_boot.sh's ensure_ssh_admin_access() treats as the single source of truth for whether the operator key belongs in the SSH addon's authorized_keys on the next Core start). A comment in each file now names the other, since a future edit to one alone would either revoke the key while the toggle still reads on (timer longer than the timestamp) or leave the operator key installed past the moment the UI says the window closed (timestamp longer than the timer). Nothing else changed: the grant and revoke paths, disable_remote_support.sh's logic, the operator key, and every other file in the fleet are untouched. dashboards/system.yaml's Remote Support card is the only owner-facing mention of the number and now says 4 hours; disable_remote_support.sh's header comment follows. The update restarts Core by itself through cytech_update.sh's PACKAGES_CHANGED path (packages/cytech.yaml is in this release's files), so the new duration goes live with no owner action and no extra restart. Live-verified on cytech.local before publication: toggle on -> .remote_support_expires_at = now + 14400 and timer.remote_support_access counting down from 4:00:00, operator key present in the addon's authorized_keys within seconds, then the expiry path (the timer run with a short test duration) switching the toggle off and revoking the key, and the System Health card reading 4 hours.
